thread:
alex: CI alert: PR 12999 triggered our smallbench perf guard on the kv-prefetch path and kernel-affinity microbench. link: https://ci.redwood.local/rs/12999/artifacts :warning:
ci-bot: job smallbench/kvcache_prefetch (linux-gpu) failed threshold: +11.3% wall time vs baseline
priya: ugh. this is the canary that rolled batching-prefetch-heuristic last night, right?
alex: yeah merged ~6h ago (PR 12950). failing test is 'kvcache_prefetch_hotpath.small_latency'
juan: paste of the diff that landed?
alex: ```diff
--- a/runtime/batcher/prefetcher.cc
+++ b/runtime/batcher/prefetcher.cc
@@ -78,7 +78,9 @@
-  if (seq_len_hint > 64) schedule_prefetch(16);
+  // prefer aggressive prefetch for mixed seqlen workloads
+  if (seq_len_hint > 48) schedule_prefetch(24);
+  if (avg_batch_size < 3) postpone_prefetch();
```
melissa: ok that's plausible. nudging prefetch size up can increase KV traffic and evict useful entries 
priya: can reproduce locally on a dev image: `tests/smallbench --bench kvcache_prefetch_hotpath --runs 30` gives ~9% median regression on an a100 emulator
juan: any kernel-selector changes in that PR? affinity code touched in runtime/kernel_selector.cc earlier this week by PR 12970 but separate.
alex: I ran perf and got this CPU symbol hotlist from the failing run:
```
BatchScheduler::dispatch_prefetch  41.2%
KVCache::evict_if_needed          17.8%
KernelSelector::score_affinity    12.4%
BatchScheduler::selectKernel      9.1%
cudaMemcpyAsync                   3.6%
```
priya: interesting KernelSelector::score_affinity at 12% — maybe more frequent kernel churn due to prefetch increasing seqlen variance?
melissa: Also saw higher tail latencies in the flamegraph: https://graphs.ci.redwood/local/12999/flame.svg (short link)
juan: plan: reproduce, bisect the last 3 merges (12950 batching-prefetch-heuristic, 12970 kernel-selector-tweak, 12982 small perf doc cleanup). which one to try first?
alex: start with 12950 since it directly touches prefetch. can you run a bisect run against our smallbench suite?
priya: kicking off bisect job now: `ci-bisect --suite smallbench --range 12940..12990 --bench kvcache_prefetch_hotpath`
ci-bot: bisect started: job id 987654. ETA ~45m. artifacts will post to thread when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
melissa: meanwhile can we add a quick instrumentation: count_kv_evictions per second in the smallbench harness to correlate?
juan: added a one-line metric in harness, running quick smoke to warm cache for 30s then bench, will post numbers
priya: smoke run shows evictions/sec baseline ~120, failing ~210
alex: that's a big delta. if prefetch size up is causing thrash we should see higher remote fetches too
melissa: logged remote_fetches: baseline 840/min, failing 1340/min
juan: bisect update: commit 12950 -> bad, 12942 -> good, bisecting..
ci-bot: bisect result: first bad commit identified: 12950 (batching-prefetch-heuristic) — job 987654 complete
alex: well that pins it. do we want to revert or tweak heuristics?
priya: revert is fastest for rollout blocker. I'll open revert PR against main (revert PR 12950) and run smallbench against it, patch name: revert-12950-prefetch
juan: can we also propose a safer fallback: cap prefetch_memory_ratio and tie prefetch to kv_hitrate threshold before increasing size?
melissa: agree. propose algorithm: only increase prefetch_size when p90_seq_len > 64 AND kv_hitrate > 0.85, otherwise keep legacy size.
alex: fine. Priya — open revert, run canary. Juan and Melissa — prototype heuristic patch in a branch and target a follow-up PR with improved telemetry
priya: revert PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/revert-12950 . running CI now. will follow up with canary rollout plan after green
melissa: also add a perf unit to assert evictions/sec delta < 20% for kvcache_prefetch_hotpath so we catch this earlier
juan: noted, I'll add test and a short doc blurb for the heuristic rationale
alex: thanks team. good catch on the bisect. cc @eng-oncall if rollback crosses release window
ci-bot: revert PR CI: all smallbench jobs queued. :white_check_mark:
priya: local + CI revert run both look good, regression gone, will merge on green
melissa: afterwards let's roll the improved heuristic with more conservative defaults and add telemetry counters to track prefetch-induced evictions over time
alex: nice work. closing the loop once revert is merged and new PR is ready. :thumbsup:
